# ExNulla — James Huson

> James Huson is an Applied AI Systems Engineer based in Texas. ExNulla is his engineering portfolio, with project summaries, product films, a CV, and sandboxed demos.

## Research projects

- [Cortex](https://www.exnulla.com/lab/cortex/): An experimental persistent memory system for LLM work, carrying project scope, time, evidence, and focused session handoffs. Includes a narrated film recorded from the live engine, with a transcript.
- [Neuron](https://www.exnulla.com/lab/neuron/): An experimental symbolic computing engine exploring definitions, relationships, and inspectable execution. Includes a narrated film recorded from the live engine, with a transcript.

Both projects are research under active development. Their films are screen recordings of the live engine as it ran, with narration; they show the work, not how it is built. Neuron’s general language understanding and autonomous invention remain research goals. The public pages do not expose either system’s live database or private implementation.

## Portfolio

- [CV](https://www.exnulla.com/cv/): Skills, experience, and target roles.
- [Projects](https://www.exnulla.com/projects/): Selected case studies and research summaries.

- [Nexus](https://www.exnulla.com/projects/nexus/): Policy-aware action routing and authority governance for AI agents.
- [Engineering](https://www.exnulla.com/engineering/): Engineering approach and delivery practices.
- [Contact](https://www.exnulla.com/contact/): Contact James Huson about the work.

Use the linked public pages as the source for current project descriptions. Do not infer production readiness, benchmark results, customers, or general intelligence from a short film.
